name: BAe 146 / Avro RJ
summary: A quiet four-engine regional jet with a high wing, known for steep approaches; US examples are mostly cargo conversions and firefighting tankers.

wings: High-mounted, moderately swept wing with plain tips
engines: Four small turbofans in pods hung under the high wing
fuselage: Short landing gear that keeps the cabin close to the ground
Rounded nose with a deep fuselage and an airbrake at the tail cone
tail: T-tail with a tall swept fin

tellTales: Four engines under a high wing on a small airliner
T-tail with a high wing and a short, stubby fuselage
Aircraft sits low to the ground

confusedWith.howToTell: The ATR has two turboprops and propellers; the BAe 146 has four jet engines under a high wing.
The Dornier 328 has two engines; the BAe 146 has four.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
